Choose the role you need.

**Builder**
Apply if you are planning to launch, already launched, or need builder support.

**Guild Leader**
Apply if you represent a community/guild and want to coordinate testnet activity.

**Vibe Viber**
Coming later. This will be automatic wallet/NFT verification when the NFT role goes live.

Roles do not guarantee rewards, allocation, NFTs, mainnet support, or prio
